How the data is collected

Each day, a GitHub Actions workflow searches the IFoA public directory for Fellows holding each type of practising certificate and saves the results. This dashboard combines those snapshots.

  • Holding a certificate. A certificate counts as held from the first snapshot it appears in. It counts as relinquished only once it has been missing from at least 3 successful snapshots spanning more than 30 days, so a brief drop-out from the directory isn’t counted as a change.
  • Dates of changes are the first snapshot that shows the change. After a gap in the data, the change could have happened at any time during the gap.
  • CERA counts anyone shown as CERA in any snapshot. The directory used since 2026 rarely shows CERA, so people who became CERA or first appeared since then are undercounted.
  • Qualification year is the year shown with the Fellow’s status in the directory.
  • People are matched by name, so two people with the same name and certificate are treated as one.
  • The first snapshot was taken on 16 Aug 2022. There are 601 successful snapshots in total.

spells = transpose(spells_raw).map(d => ({
  ...d,
  name: `${d.first_name} ${d.last_name}`,
  first_date: new Date(d.first_date),
  last_date: new Date(d.last_date),
  joined_after: d.joined_after ? new Date(d.joined_after) : null,
  left_before: d.left_before ? new Date(d.left_before) : null
}))
snapshots = snapshot_dates_raw.map(d => new Date(d))
latest = snapshots[snapshots.length - 1]
day = 864e5
minYear = d3.min(spells, d => d.qualification_year)
maxYear = d3.max(spells, d => d.qualification_year)
dark = Generators.observe(notify => {
  // Follows the dashboard's light/dark toggle so chart colours use the step validated for that surface.
  const check = () => notify(document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark"));
  check();
  const observer = new MutationObserver(check);
  observer.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]});
  return () => observer.disconnect();
})

statBox = function(icon, label, value, note) {
  // One summary figure per card, laid out the same in every card so labels, icons and values line up across
  // the row: a one-line label, then a Bootstrap icon beside the large value, then an optional status line.
  return html`<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 0 4px; min-width: 0;">
    <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.8; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" title=${label}>${label}</div>
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;">
      <i class="bi bi-${icon}" style="font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--slider-accent);" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <span style="font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap;">${value}</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; min-height: 1.2em;">${note ?? ""}</div>
  </div>`;
}

fillCard = function(draw, reserve = 0) {
  // Redraws a chart to fill its card, leaving `reserve` pixels for legends and notes. It measures the
  // card's output area (which Quarto sizes to the card) and positions the chart absolutely, so the chart
  // can't change the size being measured.
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "position: relative; width: 100%; height: 260px;";
  const chart = document.createElement("div");
  chart.style.cssText = "position: absolute; inset: 0;";
  container.append(chart);
  let frame;
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const width = Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width);
      const height = Math.max(260, Math.floor(entry.contentRect.height) - 4);
      container.style.height = `${height}px`;
      if (width > 0) chart.replaceChildren(draw(width, height - reserve));
    });
  });
  (function attach() {
    if (!container.isConnected) return requestAnimationFrame(attach);
    observer.observe(container.closest(".cell-output") ?? container);
  })();
  return container;
}
formatDate = d3.utcFormat("%d %b %Y")
filtered = spells.filter(d =>
  certFilter.includes(d.certificate) &&
  d.qualification_year >= yearRange[0] && d.qualification_year <= yearRange[1]
)
current = filtered.filter(d => d.current)
// A change is recorded on the first snapshot that shows it, so after a data gap the real date is earlier.
events = [
  ...filtered.filter(d => d.joined_after).map(d => ({
    ...d, change: "Gained", date: d.first_date, since: d.joined_after
  })),
  ...filtered.filter(d => d.left_before).map(d => ({
    ...d, change: "Relinquished", date: d.left_before, since: d.last_date
  }))
].map(d => ({...d, after_gap: d.date - d.since > 14 * day}))
recentEvents = events
  .filter(d => d.date > latest - recentDays * day)
  .sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date)
// Holders of each selected certificate on every snapshot date, with a break in the line across data gaps.
holdersOverTime = certs.filter(c => certFilter.includes(c)).flatMap(certificate => {
  const certSpells = filtered.filter(d => d.certificate === certificate);
  const rows = [];
  snapshots.forEach((date, i) => {
    if (i > 0 && date - snapshots[i - 1] > 14 * day) {
      // Break the solid line across a data gap; gapBridges draws it dotted instead.
      rows.push({certificate, date: new Date((+date + +snapshots[i - 1]) / 2), holders: NaN});
    }
    const holders = certSpells.filter(d => d.first_date <= date && (d.current || d.last_date >= date)).length;
    rows.push({certificate, date, holders});
  });
  return rows;
})
gapBridges = holdersOverTime.flatMap((d, i, rows) =>
  isNaN(d.holders) ? [
    {...rows[i - 1], bridge: `${d.certificate} ${i}`},
    {...rows[i + 1], bridge: `${d.certificate} ${i}`}
  ] : []
)
viewof certFilter = {
  const input = Inputs.checkbox(certs, {value: certs.filter(c => c !== "Scheme"), label: "Certificate"});
  // One certificate per line rather than wrapping several onto a row.
  input.querySelector(":scope > div").style.cssText = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;";
  return input;
}
viewof yearRange = {
  // Two handles on one track; each stops at the other so "from" can never pass "to".
  const form = html`<div class="year-range">
    <style>
      body { --slider-accent: #2a78d6; }
      body.quarto-dark { --slider-accent: #3987e5; }
      .slider-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
      .recent-days input { width: 100%; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--slider-accent); }
      .year-range, .recent-days { margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; }
      .year-range-track { position: relative; height: 24px; }
      .year-range-rail, .year-range-fill { position: absolute; top: 10px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }
      .year-range-rail { left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.3); }
      .year-range-fill { background: var(--slider-accent); }
      .year-range input {
        position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 24px; margin: 0;
        background: none; pointer-events: none; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
      }
      .year-range input::-webkit-slider-thumb {
        pointer-events: auto; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--slider-accent); border: none; cursor: pointer;
      }
      .year-range input::-moz-range-thumb {
        pointer-events: auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--slider-accent); border: none; cursor: pointer;
      }
    </style>
    <div class="slider-header"><span>Qualified</span><output></output></div>
    <div class="year-range-track">
      <div class="year-range-rail"></div>
      <div class="year-range-fill"></div>
      <input type="range" min=${minYear} max=${maxYear} step="1" value=${minYear} aria-label="Qualified from">
      <input type="range" min=${minYear} max=${maxYear} step="1" value=${maxYear} aria-label="Qualified to">
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const [from, to] = form.querySelectorAll("input");
  const fill = form.querySelector(".year-range-fill");
  const output = form.querySelector("output");
  const position = year => `${100 * (year - minYear) / (maxYear - minYear)}%`;
  const update = moved => {
    if (+from.value > +to.value) (moved === from ? from : to).value = moved === from ? to.value : from.value;
    form.value = [+from.value, +to.value];
    output.textContent = `${from.value} – ${to.value}`;
    fill.style.left = position(+from.value);
    fill.style.right = `calc(100% - ${position(+to.value)})`;
    // If both handles reach the top year, keep "from" on top so it can still be dragged back down.
    from.style.zIndex = +from.value === maxYear ? 2 : "";
  };
  from.addEventListener("input", () => update(from));
  to.addEventListener("input", () => update(to));
  update();
  return form;
}
viewof recentDays = {
  // A plain slider with its value shown at the end of the label row, styled to match the year range.
  const form = html`<div class="recent-days">
    <div class="slider-header"><span>Recent changes (days)</span><output></output></div>
    <input type="range" min="1" max="365" step="1" value="30" aria-label="Recent changes (days)">
  </div>`;
  const input = form.querySelector("input");
  const output = form.querySelector("output");
  const update = () => {
    form.value = +input.value;
    output.textContent = input.value;
  };
  input.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();
  return form;
}

Filters apply to every page. Data comes from daily snapshots of the IFoA public directory.

dataDownload = {
  // Downloads every record behind the People page, ignoring all filters, with the People table's columns and headers.
  const button = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm w-100">Download CSV</button>`;
  button.onclick = () => {
    const isoDate = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d");
    const yesNo = d => d ? "Yes" : "No";
    const rows = d3.sort(spells, d => d.last_name, d => d.first_name).map(d => Object.fromEntries(peopleColumns.map(c => [
      peopleHeader[c],
      d[c] instanceof Date ? isoDate(d[c]) : typeof d[c] === "boolean" ? yesNo(d[c]) : d[c]
    ])));
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([d3.csvFormat(rows)], {type: "text/csv"}));
    link.download = `ifoa_practising_certificates_${isoDate(latest)}.csv`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
  };
  return html`<div>${button}<div style="font-size: 0.8rem; opacity: 0.8; margin-top: 4px;">All ${spells.length.toLocaleString()} certificate records, ignoring the filters.</div></div>`;
}
